verdict.rationale: The skills ship as SKILL.md folders with name frontmatter, and the vendor documents them working across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. A hands-on probe installed the tdd skill and its SKILL.md frontmatter read back cleanly. The pack never says the skills conform to the open Agent Skills specification, so portability is claimed but spec compliance is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of Agent Skills spec conformance, validation of frontmatter fields against the spec, and independent evidence of the same folder running unchanged in a non-Claude agent.

support.subject: As a developer, skills follow the open Agent Skills specification so the same skill folder is valid beyond this one vendor's tooling
